title: A Regiment for the Clock
premise: In 1897, Ivo Yarrow, a mapmaker's apprentice in the Baltic port city of Vellmark, is completing the great atlas his master died for when a sealed letter arrives naming the Yarrow family as conspirators in a plot to smuggle a deposed general's war chest across the border. The letter forces Ivo into the orbit of Captain Elira Voss, the intelligence officer hunting the conspiracy — and the woman he secretly promised, years ago in peacetime, to help reach safety if she ever needed it. Torn between loyalty to his dead master's memory, his family's survival, and his promise to a woman now declared an enemy of the state, Ivo discovers the atlas itself hides the route everyone is killing for. In the end, Ivo completes the atlas with the route deliberately falsified, betrays neither side entirely, and helps Elira vanish beyond the frontier as the century turns — paying for survival with the only life he ever wanted.
about_author: Ulyana Okafor is a former archivist who spent a decade cataloguing border-town records before turning to fiction. She writes historical novels about ordinary people caught in machinery built for other people's wars.

chapters.title: The Unfinished Coastline
chapters.summary: Ivo Yarrow, POV. Working late on the atlas his master Halvard died before finishing, Ivo traces a coastline from memory because the survey notes are missing. He reflects that history happens elsewhere, to other people. Emotional beat: quiet devotion shadowed by grief.

chapters.title: A Letter Under Seal
chapters.summary: Ivo, POV. A government courier delivers a sealed letter naming the Yarrow family in connection with 'the Vellmark matter' and demanding Ivo present himself within three days. His mother burns nothing but says nothing either. Emotional beat: dread arriving in official ink.

chapters.title: The Master's Last Error
chapters.summary: Ivo, POV. Searching Halvard's effects for anything explaining the letter, Ivo finds a hidden compartment: half a map, cut cleanly, and a note reading 'the route is not for sale.' Emotional beat: the first crack in his belief that his master was merely a mapmaker.

chapters.title: The Woman at the Survey Office
chapters.summary: Ivo, POV. Reporting as summoned, Ivo meets Captain Elira Voss of military intelligence — and recognizes her as Lira, the girl he knew summers ago, to whom he once swore an unguarded promise of help. She does not acknowledge knowing him. Emotional beat: recognition disguised as formality.

chapters.title: Terms of Interrogation
chapters.summary: Elira, POV. Officially questioning Ivo, Elira privately warns him the letter was bait to flush out Halvard's confederates, and that his family will be safer cooperating. She asks what he found in the master's desk. He lies. Emotional beat: two loyalties shaking hands over a table.

chapters.title: What Mother Knew
chapters.summary: Ivo, POV. Confronting his mother, Ivo learns Halvard had been paying the family quietly for years — hush money or protection, she never asked which. The family name on the letter was no accident. Emotional beat: the ground shifting under childhood.

chapters.title: The General's Coffin
chapters.summary: Elira, POV. Elira reports to her superior, Colonel Brandt, who believes the deposed General Aldric faked his death and that his war chest moves through Vellmark by spring. Elira suspects Brandt wants the money more than the man. Emotional beat: duty beginning to smell like ambition.

chapters.title: Summers We Were Nobody
chapters.summary: Ivo, POV. A flashback chapter: the summer Ivo met Lira Voss at a lakeside survey camp, before her commission, when he promised — laughing, meaning it — that if she ever needed to disappear, he'd draw her the way out. Emotional beat: tenderness that becomes a debt.

chapters.title: An Atlas Is a Weapon
chapters.summary: Ivo, POV. Studying Halvard's finished plates, Ivo realizes the missing half-map corresponds to an unpublished route through the marshes — a corridor no army has charted. Whoever holds both halves owns the border. Emotional beat: awe curdling into fear.

chapters.title: The Man Who Buys Maps
chapters.summary: Ivo, POV. A courteous stranger named Ferenc visits the shop offering absurd sums for Halvard's remaining papers. Ivo refuses; Ferenc leaves a card and a threat wrapped in politeness. Emotional beat: the market opening for his life.

chapters.title: Brandt's Quiet Offer
chapters.summary: Elira, POV. Colonel Brandt orders Elira to cultivate Ivo as an informant, hinting that promotion — and protection — await her success. Elira realizes she is being used as bait twice over. Emotional beat: resentment hardening into resolve.

chapters.title: Half a Promise
chapters.summary: Ivo, POV. Elira comes to the shop alone, off duty, and finally speaks as Lira: she tells him Aldric may be alive, that the chest is real, and that if he finds the route first, honest men might control it instead of wolves. Emotional beat: the old promise waking up.

chapters.title: The Night Watchman's Ledger
chapters.summary: Ivo, POV. Following Halvard's old habits, Ivo bribes a night watchman for his ledgers and finds the master made eleven trips toward the marshes in his final year. Emotional beat: the thrill of detection, and its cost.

chapters.title: Brother Against the Tide
chapters.summary: Ivo, POV. Ivo's brother Tomas, a dockworker with debts, has already been approached by Ferenc's men to watch Ivo. Tomas confesses, ashamed. Emotional beat: family love strained by survival.

chapters.title: The Marsh Road Reconnaissance
chapters.summary: Elira, POV. Elira surveys the marsh corridor officially and finds fresh corduroy logging — someone is preparing the route for heavy transport this spring. She reports partially, withholding her suspicion of Brandt. Emotional beat: her first deliberate act of treachery.

chapters.title: What Halvard Died For
chapters.summary: Ivo, POV. An old colleague of Halvard's, dying, tells Ivo the master refused to sell the route to both sides and paid for it. 'He drew the truth and they killed him for where it led.' Emotional beat: inheritance of a martyrdom.

chapters.title: The Card Left Burning
chapters.summary: Ivo, POV. The shop is ransacked; the false papers are taken, the true atlas untouched — they don't yet know which is which. Ivo understands he is now valuable alive. Emotional beat: violation, then cold clarity.

chapters.title: Two Kinds of Orders
chapters.summary: Elira, POV. Brandt orders Elira to let Ferenc's buyers proceed and intercept the chest at the border — letting the theft happen so he can seize it clean. Elira sees the trap forming around everyone including herself. Emotional beat: obedience becoming complicity.

chapters.title: The Reassembled Map
chapters.summary: Ivo, POV. Using the stolen half-map's dimensions and Halvard's plate, Ivo reconstructs the full route — and finds a second marking: a safehouse symbol at the old lakeside camp. Their summer place. Emotional beat: the past weaponized.

chapters.title: Midwinter Truce
chapters.summary: Ivo and Elira, alternating. Meeting at the safehouse, they strike an uneasy private pact: find the chest before Brandt or Ferenc, and use it to buy passage out — together, if it comes to that. Emotional beat: love rekindling inside conspiracy.

chapters.title: Tomas Makes His Choice
chapters.summary: Tomas, POV. Pressed by Ferenc's men with threats against their mother, Tomas gives them a date — the spring thaw — believing he can warn Ivo after. Emotional beat: betrayal committed out of love.

chapters.title: The Colonel's Ledger
chapters.summary: Elira, POV. Breaking into Brandt's office, Elira confirms he has been corresponding with Ferenc for months — the colonel is selling the interception to the highest bidder. Emotional beat: the enemy wearing her own uniform.

chapters.title: A Map Drawn Twice
chapters.summary: Ivo, POV. Ivo prepares two versions of the atlas's final plate: one true, one subtly wrong — a route that drowns in the spring melt. He tells no one, not even Elira. Emotional beat: the mapmaker learning that truth can be drawn selectively.

chapters.title: Arrest at Dawn
chapters.summary: Ivo, POV. Soldiers arrest Ivo's mother as leverage; Brandt offers her freedom for the completed route. Ivo realizes Tomas's confession reached the wrong ears first. Emotional beat: guilt arriving ahead of grief.

chapters.title: The Bargain in the Cell Corridor
chapters.summary: Elira, POV. Elira confronts Brandt privately with evidence of his correspondence, forcing a standoff: he needs her silence; she needs the mother released. A truce of mutual blackmail. Emotional beat: power exchanged like contraband.

chapters.title: Thaw
chapters.summary: Ivo, POV. The ice breaks on the river; the smuggling operation begins moving. Ivo, released under watch, slips his handlers using routes only he knows. Emotional beat: the hunted becoming the guide.

chapters.title: The Chest on the Marsh Road
chapters.summary: Ivo and Elira, alternating. They intercept the convoy at the corduroy crossing and discover the 'chest' guarded by men wearing Brandt's own insignia — the colonel is robbing his own operation. Emotional beat: the plot revealing its rotten heart.

chapters.title: General Aldric, Living
chapters.summary: Ivo, POV. At the lakeside safehouse, Ivo meets the general himself — alive, tired, and willing to trade the entire fortune for safe passage for his surviving officers. He asks Ivo to draw them out. Emotional beat: history asking him personally.

chapters.title: Ferenc Collects
chapters.summary: Ferenc, POV (brief). Ferenc, having bought Tomas's date and Brandt's greed, moves to take everything at once — and reveals he has been Aldric's paymaster all along, playing every side. Emotional beat: the spider stepping into the light.

chapters.title: The Burning Plate
chapters.summary: Ivo, POV. With Ferenc's men closing in, Ivo must choose which version of the final plate to deliver. He sends the drowning-route forgery to Ferenc and keeps the truth. Emotional beat: the first fully chosen lie.

chapters.title: Betrayal at the Crossing
chapters.summary: Elira, POV. Brandt springs his ambush at the marsh crossing using the forged route's true terminus — Elira realizes too late that Ivo's forgery had a flaw, and that her report fed it to him. Emotional beat: her treachery turned against her.

chapters.title: The Drowning Ground
chapters.summary: Ivo, POV. The spring melt swallows the convoy on the false route; Brandt, pursuing personally, goes down with his evidence and ambitions. Ivo watches from the ridge, unable to feel triumph. Emotional beat: survival without victory.

chapters.title: What Tomas Paid
chapters.summary: Ivo, POV. Tomas, wounded helping the officers escape as penance, reconciles with Ivo on the road — each forgiving what the other did to survive. Emotional beat: brotherhood rebuilt on shared guilt.

chapters.title: The Price Named Aloud
chapters.summary: Ivo and Elira, alternating. Safe briefly, they confront the truth: helping Aldric escape brands Elira a traitor. There is no version where she stays. The promise must be kept now or never. Emotional beat: love choosing its shape.

chapters.title: The Century's Last Convoy
chapters.summary: Ivo, POV. Guiding Aldric's officers along the true route by night, Ivo uses every trick Halvard taught him. At the frontier stone, the general offers him wealth; Ivo takes only the master's survey notes back. Emotional beat: refusing the prize to keep the self.

chapters.title: The Frontier Stone
chapters.summary: Ivo, POV. Elira crosses. At the boundary, Ivo keeps the summer promise at last — drawing her the way out, in full, signed. They part without promises of return, because the century itself is closing. Emotional beat: devotion fulfilled as farewell.

chapters.title: Aftermath in Ink
chapters.summary: Ivo, POV. Weeks later, Ivo completes the atlas, publishing the coastline honestly and the marshes blank — 'uncharted.' Officials read it as diligence. Only he knows it is a grave marker and a gift. Emotional beat: mourning made permanent.

chapters.title: The Letter He Writes
chapters.summary: Ivo, POV. Ivo writes to Elira care of a neutral postal house, enclosing no words — only a small corrected map of the lakeside camp, so she'll know it still exists somewhere. Emotional beat: hope reduced to cartography.

chapters.title: What History Does
chapters.summary: Elira, POV. Across the border, Elira reads the blank marshes in a smuggled copy of the atlas and understands exactly what he gave up and protected. She begins her own map home. Emotional beat: mirrored fidelity across a line.

chapters.title: A Regiment for the Clock
chapters.summary: Ivo, POV, New Year's Eve 1899. Bells mark the century's turn; Ivo stands in the shop with his mother and Tomas, the atlas done, the promise kept, the price paid. History happened to him after all — and he survived it by choosing, at last, what to be loyal to. Emotional beat: hard-won peace.
